title: Drinking-water container child and pet protection
summary: A household boundary for protecting stored drinking water from dipping hands, pet bowls, floor contact, unlabeled treatment status, and accidental greywater mixing.
content: Core sequence: 1) Store drinking water above greywater and away from pet feeding areas, trash, fuel, and cleaning products. 2) Use a pouring method instead of dipping cups or hands into the container. 3) Label treated, untreated, and non-drinking water with large simple marks. 4) Give children and pet caregivers separate small containers so the main supply stays closed.
